integrity: Contains an original self-contained valuation and finite-field proof and a standalone deterministic finite verifier; does not claim formal or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only quadratic residues modulo odd integers; no even-modulus claim, no higher power sets, no rates or higher-order correlations. Published indexed Fourier analysis of complete square sets was not accessible in full, and an equivalent prior formulation may exist. Proof is textual with finite computation as a check; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Exact two-point square-residue correlations on odd residue rings and a prime-power reversal
